name: traxide
description: A fast autorouter: routes the open board in seconds.
description_full: Routes the board open in KiCad with traxide: KiCad exports it as Specctra DSN, traxide routes it, and KiCad imports the result, which replaces the board's tracks and vias. traxide is a fast, dependency-free autorouter written in Rust, licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0.
